_description: Zero-Bug Architecture Chunk 17 — writable-fields whitelist for CarsPaymentSuccessDetails/{docId}/partnerChat/{messageId} update operations. Governs the OUTER hasOnly() safety check on read-receipt updates. The inner branch-specific hasOnly checks (customer→readAtByCustomer, partner→readAtByPartner) enforce cross-role spoofing prevention and are captured by rule semantics, not by this manifest.
_provenance: MAD Session-20e Item 6a 2026-08-30 — new subcollection rule inside CarsPaymentSuccessDetails match block, for R3 in-app partner-customer chat. Mobile customer-side already ships (behind RC flag partner_chat_enabled default false); partner-side ships in Zymo-Partner PWA + FCM setup (Items 6b/6c) + push-fanout trigger (Item 6d); RC flag flips post 6d smoke test (Item 6e).

_kept_field_reason.readAtByCustomer: customer-side read-receipt timestamp. Only the parent booking's UserId may flip this (enforced by inner branch hasOnly). Written by messaging_screen.dart mark-read pass at :78-95 as serverTimestamp via set-merge.
_kept_field_reason.readAtByPartner: partner-side read-receipt timestamp. Only the parent booking's vendorId may flip this (enforced by inner branch hasOnly). Will be written by Zymo-Partner chat inbox UI when Item 6c ships.

excludedByDesign.senderId: immutable after create — spoofing would let a customer impersonate the partner
excludedByDesign.senderRole: immutable after create — same reason as senderId
excludedByDesign.text: immutable after create — message tampering vector
